description: Four story-telling chart features on one Svelte 5 line chart. overlay adds a smoothing or trend line, sma:7, ema:14 or linear regression, dashed and tinted over the source series; annotations pin text and markers at named events such as releases and incidents; yScale log plots base-10 for signups that run from dozens to thousands; and onDrill fires with the rowIds behind a clicked category so the demo filters the grid to that day's rows.
keywords: svelte chart drill to grid rows

faq.question: How do I add a moving average?
faq.answer: Set overlay on the series to sma:7 for a seven-point simple moving average, ema:14 for an exponential one or linear for a regression line; the chart computes and draws it from the series values.

faq.question: What does onDrill receive?
faq.answer: The clicked category and the ids of the rows that were aggregated into it, so the grid can be filtered to exactly those rows without recomputing the grouping.

faq.question: How are annotations placed?
faq.answer: Each annotation names a category and carries text and an optional marker; the chart positions it at that x with a callout so the event is explained on the plot.
